item.title: Student Senate Meeting
item.description: Get involved in student leadership at LTCC! All are welcome to the next Student Senate meeting on Tuesday, Feb. 8 from 12pm-1pm in the Board Room/L104 in the library building. item.title: Spoken Word Artist David Oliver
item.description: Celebrate Black History Month through the power of language! Spoken word artist David M. Oliver joins LTCC via Zoom to share some of his performance poetry, and stories of family, social justice, and African American culture as he's experienced it. Listen in on Thursday, Feb. 10 from 12pm-1pm via Zoom: https://cccconfer.zoom.us/j/95435034644.Oliver, also known as Judah 1, began writing poetry and song at the age of 7. After his best friend's untimely death by suicide at age 16, Oliver has been on a mission to ensure that young men know how to use the Power of Voice, the Power of Community, the Power of Faith, and the Power of Knowledge. Oliver is the author of two books of poetry, is the founder of the LionLike MindState Poetry Series, and Director of LionLikeINC. He's taught art and expression at various levels, from first graders to university workshops, and has also taught Spoken Word as Anger Management at the Camp Glen Rocky Detention Camp for Boys in San Dimas. He's also been an Artist/Instructor for the Prioson Education Project, and has taught at Chino Men's Prison, Chino Women's Prison, and the CA Rehabilitation Center for Men.

item.title: How to Combat Anti-Blackness Workshop
item.description: Learn practical tools and tips to address anti-black behaviors and ways of thinking in your daily life. This free virtual workshop provides a safe space for participants to explore their own hidden biases, and discover ways to combat them and become a better ally to Black Americans. Join us on Tuesday, February 15 from 12pm-1:30pm online. To register and receive a Zoom link to participate, head here.

item.title: Black History Month Movie & Discussion
item.description: Let's go to the movies to mark Black History Month! Join us in LTCC's Duke Theatre for a free viewing of Just Mercy, a 2019 film starring Michael B. Jordan, Jamie Foxx, and Brie Larson. This gripping legal drama describes the true story of a Black man from Alabama who was wrongly sentenced to death for a murder he didn't commit. Bring your mask, and join us in the Duke Theatre/Fine Arts Building on Wednesday, Feb. 16 from 5pm-8pm for the movie and an enlightening discussion afterwards.

item.title: Lincoln & Washington Birthday Holiday Closures

item.title: Kiwanis Club Scholarship Application Deadline
item.description: Free money for college! The Kiwanis Club of Lake Tahoe is providing a scholarship just for current LTCC students, and it's free to apply. For full consideration, submit your completed application by Friday, April 8, 2022. A complete application includes the Google Form application itself, an unofficial transcript (required), and a letter of recommendation/reference (optional but strongly encouraged). Visit the Kiwanis Lake Tahoe webpage for full information and a link to apply! Reference letters and transcripts must be emailed to kiwanisbaunhauserscholarships@gmail.com.
